A hidden treasure !
Nov 2023 • Couples
This is a quirky little cafe in a quiet (for HCMC) side street. The laid- back casual vibe would provide a relaxing venue for a quiet coffee, but actually delivers some seriously tasty food.
Our servers were clearly being trained, but were efficient and attentive without being over the top. We had two very tasty and filling dishes and my iced coconut coffee was delicious and refreshing. 
I feel like its a genuine shame that our travel plans mean we probably won't be able to go back, but a definite must visit if you're in the area.

Wonderful Food and a Great Vibe overall
Oct 2022
While staying at Christina's, having this gem downstairs made my stay even more wonderful. The food was delicious, and everything was so fresh and flavorful. I had quite a few things on the menu, but by far my favorite was the Vegan Banh Mi. It was such a nice meal to have before heading out for the day. I really enjoyed having the café where I was staying because, with everything being so good, I didn't really need to leave the building. One of the more special things about this place was that there was live music during my stay, and that really sealed the deal for me. I love having a nice meal in a nice lively and relaxing environment. I'd rate this place higher if I could, but I suppose the 5/5 will have to do.
